name: dsh-remote-control
description: DSH Remote Control host plugin: pairs a running DeepSeek Harness with the DRC relay so a WeChat Mini Program can send prompts, watch streamed output, and answer approvals. Payload-level E2E encryption; the relay never sees plaintext.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test dist/tests/window.test.js dist/tests/runtime.test.js dist/tests/sleep.test.js dist/tests/qr.test.js dist/tests/config.test.js dist/tests/status.test.js dist/tests/guard.test.js dist/tests/relay-client.test.js
